subject: Discuss AI auto-tagging of meals on entry (high protein, high sodium, etc.)
description: When logging a meal, have AI infer the tag values (High protein, High sodium, etc.) from the free-text Description/PortionNote instead of (or pre-filling) manual tag selection. MealEntry.Tags is already a CSV consumed via TagList, so output maps straight onto the existing field. Concerns to discuss: each meal entry would cost a Gemini API call — consider batching (tag untagged meals during the daily AI check-in / GeminiAnalyzer run instead of per-entry), an on-save call with suggested tags the user confirms, or a cheap local keyword fallback when offline/no key. Tags should stay user-editable (AI suggests, user can correct); decide whether AI-suggested tags are visually distinguished. Constrain the model to the app's known tag vocabulary so tags stay consistent for trends/insights.
